title: anamnesis-source/v1
description: One admitted source: the producer's own bytes, identified by digest, with the provenance that says where they came from and the rights that say what may be done with them. A normalised record never replaces this. The validator in skills/anamnesis/scripts/anamnesis.py is the executable authority; this file declares the same closed shape for a reader.

id.description: Stable identifier for this source within the corpus. Unique; a duplicate is a refusal.

path.description: Location of the preserved bytes, relative to the policy root. Must resolve to an ordinary file inside that root without following a symlink.

sha256.description: Exact SHA-256 of the preserved bytes. A mismatch is a refusal, not a warning.

bytes.description: Exact byte count of the preserved bytes, checked against the observed size and the policy's cap.

media_type.description: How the bytes are to be read. Curation reads only types it declares a mapper for.

producer.description: Who produced the source record, as the source itself names them.

provenance.description: Where the preserved bytes were taken from. Preservation copies bytes; this records the origin so the copy can be traced back to it.

origin.description: The repository, engagement or publication the bytes came from.

origin_commit.description: The exact commit the bytes were taken at, where the origin is a Git repository. Absent means the origin did not establish one; it does not mean the latest.

retrieved.description: ISO 8601 date the bytes were preserved.
